arguments.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ submission/crosscheck/__pycache__ && find submission | sort && python3 -c "
import os
total=0; entries=0
for base, dirs, files in os.walk('submission'):
    for name in dirs+files:
        entries+=1
        p=os.path.join(base,name)
        if os.path.isfile(p): total+=os.lstat(p).st_size
print('entries', entries, 'bytes', total, '(limits: 256 entries, 2 MiB)')"
